title: TEMA-ENM: An Interpretable Attention-Topology Framework Decouples Affinity and Efficacy from Sequence Alone
description:
TEMA-ENM is an interpretable deep transfer-learning framework that decouples binding affinity from signaling efficacy using a bilinear attention network, from protein sequence alone. Starting from the pre-trained BiLSTM-BAN protein–ligand model (bioRxiv 2026, doi:10.64898/2026.05.10.724184), it is fine-tuned on the growth hormone secretagogue receptor (GHSR) with 1,539 ligands, achieves AUROC = 0.96, and infers activation- versus inhibition-associated residues and their co-attention network topology without crystallographic priors.
